name: Danganronpa: Salvation's Fears
source:
Follow the Ultimate Hero, Nagamori Saemonsaburu, and his sister Mari throughout a game of old tropes with new twists! After some... Interesting introductions, only two questions remain: Exactly how much blood will be spilled, and how many people can the Ultimate Hero himself lead to salvation?

[From [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/dr-salvations-fears/849935]GameJolt[/url]]
